claims.claimText: CAC reduces Unsafe Intent Execution Rate (UIER) from >75% (B0, B1) to 0.00% across all evaluated adversarial failure classes F1-F11.
claims.requiredStatisticalTest: Paired McNemar test with Edwards continuity correction, Risk Difference (RD) with 95% Wald CI

claims.claimText: Hypothesis H1: CAC significantly reduces unsafe intent effects relative to unconstrained tool execution (B0) and passive authorization-only logging (B1) across F1-F11.
Hypothesis H2: Test-time compute scaling (B4 Best-of-N voting) cannot substitute for external cryptographic evidence in scenarios F1, F2, and F5.
claims.requiredMetric: UIER, Assurance acquisition cost ($USD), Reasoning overhead (ms)

claims.claimText: Hypothesis H3: Multi-witness static quorums (B5) and unmodeled quorums (CAC-NoEFD) suffer quorum illusions under correlated partitions (F4), while CAC evaluates kappa_E < tau to block unsafe execution.
claims.requiredExperiment: Scenario F4 Correlated Control Plane Partition
claims.requiredMetric: Correlated Unsafe Approval Rate, kappa_E, UIER
claims.requiredBaselineOrAblation: CAC vs B5, CAC vs CAC-NoEFD
claims.measuredEffect: B5 UIER = 100.0%, CAC-NoEFD UIER = 100.0%, CAC UIER = 0.00%, RD = 1.000, p < 0.0001

claims.claimText: Hypothesis H4: On low-risk operations (E1), CAC adapts obligation sets to achieve non-inferior safe completion with sub-millisecond overhead compared to uniform Tier 3 obligations (CAC-NoAdaptiveOmega).
claims.requiredMetric: SICR (Safe Intent Completion Rate), Resident overhead (ms), TTSR (ms)
claims.requiredStatisticalTest: Non-inferiority parity test on SICR, overhead comparison
claims.measuredEffect: SICR = 100.0% for both (RD = 0.0), overhead reduced 55x (0.004 ms vs 0.220 ms)

claims.claimText: Hypothesis H5: Dispatch-time gateway guards intercept TOCTOU state invalidation (F5), whereas ablating guards (CAC-NoGuard) permits unsafe execution.
claims.measuredEffect: CAC-NoGuard UIER = 100.0%, CAC UIER = 0.00%, RD = 1.000, p < 0.0001

claims.claimText: CAC resident controller mediation overhead remains sub-millisecond across all tiers (p50 <= 0.21 ms, p99 <= 0.46 ms in Tier 3).
claims.requiredMetric: tauResolve, tauVerify, tauMint, tauGatewayLocal, tauGuardIo percentiles (p50, p90, p99, max)

claims.claimText: When core assumptions are intentionally violated (BND1-BND4), CAC fails as formally predicted, confirming the necessity of its theoretical prerequisites.
claims.requiredMetric: Falsification passing status, admission decision, resulting effect
claims.measuredEffect: 7/7 boundary cases passed formal failure predictions (e.g. BND4 policy omission admits because authenticity != truth)
